dimensions_and_drawings.note: Nominal section wall is configuration/source-defined; access windows and joint transitions are outside the uniform section. Screw lead is an annotation/analysis input; a screw thread is not modeled.

scope: Read current CAD property, named-pose clearance, trajectory clearance and saved native release consistency evidence before running focused checks.

Reimport every one of 54 individual STEP solids and compare validity, solid count, volume and bounding box against recorded BRep properties; parse all 54 individual binary STL records and compare mesh bounds.
Reimport all six complete STEP assemblies and verify 54 solids, aggregate volume and pose bounding boxes.
Match all 54 native FreeCAD BRep objects one-to-one with named components using home-transformed center and volume, without relying on object order.
Measure modeled gripper pad opening and exact body/jaw/carriage intersections at five openings: 0, 22.5, 45, 67.5 and 90 mm; 35 exact pair tests.

Compare nine configured exterior dimensions and eight drawing annotations with current configuration; inspect cylindrical faces for the eight base through holes/counterbores and six flange holes with pitch circles.
Verify unchanged source/artifact hashes for the previous executed native Blender/render/drawing checks; these checks were reused, not rerun.
Check component/mesh/export naming, all linked catalog files, existing organized CAD copy hashes and the installed FreeCAD launcher in CheckOnly mode.

access_and_naming.new_catalog_presentation_refresh: Root-owned presentation synchronization will copy/render this new catalog after this review; existing CAD presentation artifacts were checked here.

changes_made: Added docs/component_catalog.md with links, seven assembly groups and native FreeCAD object correspondence.
limitations: This is finite digital concept verification, not hardware or manufacturing certification, continuous collision proof or validation of every joint-limit combination.
Same rigid-motion families are intentional assembled interfaces; retained all-pair clearance applies its documented exclusions and thresholds.
Five gripper positions test actual pad gaps and selected moving-jaw/fixed-body pairs. They supplement the retained complete gripper and robot clearance screens; no continuous swept proof is claimed.
Nominal section wall thickness and screw lead were reviewed as configuration/source/annotation inputs; screw threads, purchased bearing/motor/gearbox internals and tolerances remain simplified.
The native Blender scene and render readability checks were reused only after confirming every retained source and artifact hash remained unchanged.
